report.explanation: Current telemetry shows one gateway trace error calling order (913ms) while gateway, inventory, and payment metrics are healthy (p95 72ms, error_rate 0.0012). Order shows elevated retained memory (300MB, retained_after_gc) with WARN logs, but a single window cannot establish a leak or tie it to checkout degradation. Insufficient evidence for a bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Order service memory-retention time series to confirm sustained growth versus a short increase
Order service heap/GC profile or allocation breakdown to attribute retained memory
Order service latency/error metrics over a longer window to link retention to checkout degradation
Gateway-to-order trace latency baseline to distinguish downstream latency from memory pressure
